decisions: The actual wrapper sets --ratio from its required number prop. Caller precondition is finite positive ratio; there is no invented runtime validation/default. Native384×216 is one16:9 specimen, not a fixed output width.10px clipped corners and gray/6 preview surface retain observed visual values; the neutral surface is deliberately fixed rather than pretending it is a theme mode. Source docs explicitly show16:9,1:1 and9:16 examples and caller object-cover media. This reference adopts cover cropping with meaningful alt; the small vector image is independently authored test media, not native kit imagery. Intrinsic parent width controls both dimensions; child loading and announcements remain caller-owned.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
